blurb: In April 1954, a museum committee was formed by Juliet Rice Wichman as the chairperson and Dora Jane Isenberg Cole as a member. Mrs. Wichman and Mrs. Cole raised the necessary funds for a new building adjacent to the Wilcox library to house the Kaua i Museum, and Kenneth Roerig was selected as the architect.
